headline: Congress directed its leaders to arrange a Congressional Gold Medal award to former Senator Bob Dole for his military and public service.
what_it_does: This law tells the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for a Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to Bob Dole. The stated purpose is to recognize his service to the nation as a soldier, legislator, and statesman. It is a commemorative honor and does not create new rules, benefits, or obligations for the public.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on September 15, 2017.
